```sql
with captures as (
    select
        ci.name as key,
        a.method,
        a.amount_minor,
        row_number() over (
            partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
            order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
        ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    join cities ci on ci.city_id = s.city_id
    where not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and a.status = 'captured'
      and s.region_id = 'IN-TN'
      and a.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
),
city_emi_share as (
    select
        key,
        cast(
            sum(case when method = 'emi' then amount_minor else 0 end) * 1.0
            / nullif(sum(amount_minor), 0)
            as decimal(38,12)
        ) as value
    from captures
    where capture_rank = 1
    group by key
)
select key, value
from city_emi_share
order by value desc, key asc
limit 5
```
